sources.title: 《容齋續筆》卷一自序
sources.quality_notes: Received preface signs Shaoxi 3 third month tenth day (1192), refers to first 16 juan and separate 16-juan sequel; not exact writing date of v8 passage or physical copy date.

sources.title: 《容齋續筆》卷八〈蓍龜卜筮〉四部叢刊系受讀
sources.quality_notes: Line 8 lists ten technical labels including 三命 and 紫微 separately, plus 五星 and 六壬; author criticizes proliferating signs and social patronage. No full 紫微斗數 title or star-placement table. No original page read.

sources.title: 《容齋續筆》卷八另一受讀入口
sources.quality_notes: Line 6 corroborates the ten labels; different text route not independent Song physical evidence. Exact target folio and copy identity not bound.

sources.title: 《夷堅志》志補十八〈汴岸術士〉
sources.quality_notes: Line 199 identifies 三命 and written 年月日時; no actual four stem-branch pairs, hour stem formula, outcome verification or modern Ziping identity. Ming manuscript variants are modern editorial notes, not checked original leaves.

sources.title: 《新編分類夷堅志》辛集卷二〈汴岸術士〉
sources.quality_notes: Line 12 preserves 三命 and 年月日時; classification and received punctuation/OCR vary, e.g. 甚/正 and missing clause. Not a second independent witnessed event or established direct copying relation.

sources.title: 《容齋三筆》卷十一〈鎮星為福〉
sources.quality_notes: Lines 24–25 distinguish day Mars/night Saturn taboos in natal five-planet practice from Saturn in state astrology, and quote residence of 2 years 4 months per palace. Not Ziwei fourteen stars, Ziwei day-night or time boundary, nor verified astronomical period.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: Song technical label 紫微 does not establish modern fourteen-star Ziwei Dou Shu
三命 using four birth-time fields does not prove four complete sexagenary pairs or day-master method
Separate received routes and classified retellings are not independent contemporaneous physical witnesses
Planetary day/night taboo is not a Ziwei charting day boundary
unresolved_lineage_questions: Bind Rongzhai v8 to exact Song/early-edition original leaf and identify technical meaning of 紫微
Identify Yijian story early edition, classified compilation dependency and actual input/algorithm
Compare planetary practice sources independently without collapsing natal and state astrology
